title: Avoid Block Behavior
description: Allows this entity to avoid certain blocks.

on_escape.title: On Escape
on_escape.description:
Event triggers that fire when the entity escapes from the avoided block. Can be a single trigger or an array of triggers.

Sample values:
• hoglin: [{"event":"escaped_event","target":"self"}]

avoid_block_sound.title: Avoid Block Sound
avoid_block_sound.description:
The sound event to play when the mob is avoiding a block.

Sample values:
• hoglin: retreat

search_height.title: Search Height
search_height.description:
Maximum distance to look for a block in y.

Sample values:
• hoglin: 4

search_range.title: Search Range
search_range.description:
Maximum distance to look for a block in xz.

Sample values:
• hoglin: 8

sound_interval.title: Sound Interval

sprint_speed_modifier.title: Sprint Speed Modifier
sprint_speed_modifier.description:
Modifier for sprint speed. 1.0 means keep the regular speed, while higher numbers make the sprint speed faster.

Sample values:
• hoglin: 1

target_blocks.title: Target Blocks
target_blocks.description:
List of block types this mob avoids.

Sample values:
• hoglin: ["minecraft:warped_fungus","minecraft:portal","...

target_selection_method.title: Target Selection Method
target_selection_method.description:
Block search method.

Sample values:
• hoglin: nearest

tick_interval.title: Tick Interval
tick_interval.description:
Should start tick interval.

Sample values:
• hoglin: 5

walk_speed_modifier.title: Walk Speed Modifier
walk_speed_modifier.description:
Modifier for walking speed. 1.0 means keep the regular speed, while higher numbers make the walking speed faster.

Sample values:
• hoglin: 1

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.
